message: Build EnvLines in envlines.py. Read KEY=VALUE lines from UTF-8 stdin, skipping blank lines and lines whose first nonspace character is #. Split at the first equals sign, trim key whitespace only, preserve value exactly. Require keys matching [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*; duplicate keys use last value. Print a JSON object. Invalid lines exit 1 with line number and no stdout. Never read actual environment variables. Stdlib only.

profile.platform: local Windows and Python 3 stdlib for CLI; modern desktop/mobile browser for web
profile.defaults: Smallest solution described; no accounts, network, deployment or paid assets. Ask before scope or budget changes.
